safe_examples_cutile_wins_regular_TC_TMA: matmul_fp32_fp16_fp8 (T/C 0.788; report p2-3: 256x256x64 tile, tensor-pipe 79-81% vs 52-69%, both TMA)
flash_attention (0.941; report p24-25: 128x128 SMEM-backed tile, ~9% faster after tuning)
jacobi_stencil_2d (0.866; report p34: SMEM-staged 4x512 tile reuses halo; NOTE uses ct.gather not box load, no Tensor Core — a tile-reuse win, not a TC/TMA win)
kl_divergence (0.957; report p33-34: box-load/TMA streaming, ~8% faster)
batch_normalization fp32 only (report p29-30: SMEM-centric lowering relieves register pressure at fp32; fp16/bf16 Triton faster)
safe_examples_triton_wins_irregular: destindex (T/C 2.096; ct.scatter element-wise lowering; report p21-22)
flash_decode (3.377; runtime block loop without software pipelining, 16-CTA grid; report p23)
block_sparse_attention (2.689; CSR traversal, 2.14x instructions, SMEM staging; report p24)
linear_self_attention (Fig4 2.19x; runtime while K-loop unpipelined, z_kernel; report p22-23)
radix_sort (2.05 sweep-max; scatter stage 2.31x instructions, occupancy halved; report p8-9)
histogramming (1.78-1.93; global-atomic latency-bound, occupancy halved; report p5-7)
moe_topk_gating / cross_entropy (SMEM cross-warp reduction vs single-warp shuffle; report p35-36)
do_not_use_as_examples: top_k_selection (algorithm not aligned by design: tl.topk vs bitonic network; primitive-availability case, report p10-11)
matmul_int8 (near parity, hardware path differs: legacy IMMA vs UTCIMMA; report p18-19)
bitonic_sort (Torch baseline is a hand-written ~300-pass eager network, not torch.sort; report p32)
